# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

## [Unveiling Agri Pipes: Pioneering the Drip Irrigation Revolution in Tirupattur][9]

[ admn.kadeshwar.groups@gmail.com ][10] / October 11, 2024

The Evolution of Drip Irrigation Technology Drip irrigation, a method that delivers water directly
to the plant’s roots, has undergone a remarkable transformation since its inception. Its origins can
be traced back to ancient civilizations such as the Mesopotamians and Egyptians, who utilized simple
devices to provide water to crops. However, it wasn’t until the 20th century that technological
advancements began to shape the modern drip irrigation system we recognize today. The first modern
adaptation of drip irrigation was developed in Israel in the 1960s, where researchers aimed to
enhance water efficiency in arid environments. As agriculture faced the challenges of water scarcity
and the necessity for increased crop yields, the adoption of drip irrigation spread globally. This
method has proven to be remarkably effective across various agricultural sectors, including
vegetables, fruits, and ornamental plants. As farmers recognized the significant benefits of
precision irrigation, such as reduced water usage and enhanced crop quality, the demand for
innovations in this technology surged. Agri Pipes has emerged as a notable player in this rapidly
evolving field, contributing significantly to the advancements in drip irrigation systems. The
company’s commitment to quality manufacturing has ensured the production of reliable and durable
pipes tailored to meet the diverse needs of farmers. Through a combination of modern engineering,
extensive research, and consideration of local agricultural practices, Agri Pipes has developed
effective solutions that not only address irrigation challenges but also promote sustainability in
farming practices. Over the years, innovations such as pressure-compensating emitters, self-cleaning
filters, and advanced control systems have been pivotal in enhancing the efficiency of drip
irrigation. These advancements reflect the ongoing commitment of companies like Agri Pipes to
support farmers in optimizing water usage and improving crop yields. As the agricultural landscape
continues to evolve, the contributions of drip irrigation technology remain paramount to achieving
sustainable agricultural practices in regions like Tirupattur. Why Choose Agri Pipes for Your
Irrigation Needs? When it comes to selecting a reliable solution for your irrigation needs, Agri
Pipes stands out due to its commitment to quality and innovation. The company utilizes high-quality
materials in the production of their pipes, ensuring durability and longevity, which are essential
for agricultural applications. This focus on material excellence not only minimizes the risk of
damage but also contributes to efficient water management in fields. Agri Pipes offers a
comprehensive range of products, tailored to meet diverse agricultural requirements. From standard
drip irrigation systems to high-tech solutions equipped with advanced technology, farmers can select
from a variety of options that align with their specific needs. This versatility in product
offerings makes Agri Pipes a go-to brand for farmers seeking efficient and effective irrigation
solutions. One of the standout features of Agri Pipes is their customization options. Understanding
that agriculture is not a one-size-fits-all scenario, the company provides tailored solutions that
consider the unique aspects of different crops and soil types. This personalized approach enables
farmers to implement irrigation systems that maximize water efficiency and ensure optimal crop
growth. Customer satisfaction is paramount at Agri Pipes, and numerous testimonials serve as
evidence of the effectiveness of their systems. Farmers have reported significant improvements in
crop yields resulting from the efficient water distribution offered by Agri Pipes’ drip irrigation
services. Case studies further illustrate the positive impact of these systems on water
conservation, demonstrating lower water usage while maintaining, if not enhancing, agricultural
productivity. With these features and benefits prominently positioned, it becomes clear why
partnering with Agri Pipes for your irrigation needs is an investment in the future of your
agriculture business, emphasizing both efficiency and sustainability.

## CAPTAIN - A LEADER IN MICRO IRRIGATION

Captain is a pioneer in manufacturing of advanced micro irrigation technologies in India. Our
irrigation systems which include drip irrigation systems and sprinkler irrigation systems are
produced from advanced German and Israel technology. We have two state of the art manufacturing
facilities (Rajkot and Kurnool) to ensure the best quality products. We have a strong marketing and
distribution network with presence in 16 states of India with more than 750 dealers. Our focus on
good quality irrigation systems and agronomical services made **"CAPTAIN"** a reputed brand in
domestic and international market.

Minimal Maintenance
We build our products keeping in mind lowest maintenance and optimal performance depending on our
customer's requirements.
Powerful Design
Our products comes with latest state-of-the-art design with compact structure, best efficiency and
easily manageable during the life.
Best Quality Product
We believe in supplying best quality products. Our all products undergo stringent quality checks to
ensure best quality product.
Excellent Support
Providing excellent agronomy and after sales service to make sure our customer is happy and
satisfied with our products.


## CAPTAIN’S COMMITMENT TOWARDS THE ENVIRONMENT

Providing sustainable long term solutions towards the environment is not only a business at Captain
but a commitment towards the environment. Farmers around the world are under immense pressure due to
depleting ground water sources. Captain Polyplast’s Micro irrigation solutions helps farmers tackle
these challenges by optimizing their water utilisation efficiently by around 60% and also delivering
higher agricultural yields by controlling the soil moisture levels which aid in crop growth and also
improve yields.

#### In the financial year 2020, we covered ~40,000 hectares of land under micro irrigation, saving
#### around 20 Billion Litres of water or an equivalent amount of water to fill 8,000 Olympic size
#### swimming pools.

Ultimate Solution for Micro Irrigation
We offer superior quality drip irrigation system. Our drip irrigation system includes ISI Marked
Mainline, Submainline, Integral Drip Lines Lateral, Dripper and is supported by wide range of
fittings to suit various conditions resulting in long life of our product.
Our drip irrigation system is operated through ISI marked Screen/Disc filters.
[View More][65]

## PRODUCT RANGE

Captain offers advanced irrigation technologies in India which includes Drip Irrigation System,
Irrigation Lateral, Compression Fittings, Valves, Irrigation Filters, Pressure Gauge, Venturi
Injector, Sprinkler Irrigation System, Sprinkler Fittings, Mini Sprinkler Irrigation System, Green
House, Solar System, Fertilizer and Polymer

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

EMPIRE DRIP SUPPLY offers a comprehensive line of drip irrigation products for vegetables, fruit and
berry growers, nurseries and greenhouses, vineyards, hemp and hops growers. We are conveniently
located in western NY just off of Route 104.

We sell products from these fine vendors:

 


#### About Us

Empire Drip Supply- a new name in the New York Ag industry. Our business may be young but our team
brings two generations of experience in agriculture including several years of supplying drip
irrigation products. We offer quality names in irrigation and agriculture supplies. Our industry
specific knowledge helps us customize a comprehensive product line with a variety of tools to help
support your agricultural business. We ship daily from our warehouse located at 5951 S Geneva Rd.
Sodus, NY 14551.

#### Need help designing an irrigation system?

We are happy to help! Give us basic information on our handy design form, and we can give you a
quote of the overall design. If you choose to purchase the system, you will get a full map design,
an itemized and detailed parts list, and free support from our designer!

#### Pick Up, Shipping & Delivery
* Customers are encouraged to come pick up their orders from our facility.
* Customer is responsible for all shipping costs. We use USPS & UPS daily for small items, and LTL
  carriers for pallet quantities.
* As a customer service, we are working to arrange pooled delivery service into various areas of NYS
  and surrounding.
* Please help us get your product quickly and cost effectively by placing your order at least a week
  in advance of when you need it, that way you have the greatest opportunity to save on shipping!

#### Terms and Conditions

We accept all major credit cards; cash, check or money order. Claims for shortage or damaged items
MUST be made within 7 days of receipt of shipment. All prices subject to change without notice.
Credit card payments for amounts over $3,000 are subject to a 2% credit card fee.

#### Returns

All returns for credit must include invoice and may have a 10% restocking charge.

#### Special Orders

Custom order items are non-refundable and must be paid in advance

# Geospace Technologies

## [Smart Water][90]

Our smart water products enable the global smart water utility and asset protection markets with
robust water-proof connectors and cloud-based remote shut-off valves. We serve utility and water
management districts, commercial and multi-family residential asset managers, and those designing
the smart water management systems of the future.

[Learn More][91]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Energy Solutions][92]

Our energy solutions technologies deliver actionable information for energy exploration and mitigate
risk in the new energy economy. Our leading seismic sensing technologies serve customers with
exploration products, reservoir monitoring, and energy transition applications.

[Learn More][93]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Intelligent Industrial][94]

Our Intelligent Industrial offerings harness technology pedigree with our deep-sensing capability to
deliver empowering, informative, and efficient tools to our global customers. Our sensing
technologies reach well beyond our roots in energy to improve national and homeland security and
surveillance.

[Learn More][95]

## Our Purpose

Geospace partners with customers to solve their toughest challenges, delivering innovative solutions
and sustainable long-term value to our key stakeholders.

[Learn More][96]

## How Does Drip Irrigation Work?

Drip irrigation is a cutting-edge irrigation technique that delivers water directly to the root zone
of plants, optimizing water usage and promoting healthier plant growth. Here’s how this efficient
system works:

Water Source:

Water is drawn from a reservoir, tank, or mainline supply, ensuring a steady and reliable source for
irrigation.

Filtration System:

High-quality filters remove impurities and debris from the water, preventing clogging and ensuring a
smooth operation of the system.

Mainline and Subline Pipes:

Water is transported through durable main and subline pipes to the desired irrigation zones.

Drip Emitters:

Precision-engineered GhafDrip inline emitters release controlled amounts of water directly to the
soil, ensuring targeted hydration to the plants’ roots.

simple - to provide reliable, innovative solutions that help farmers save time, water, and money.

## FAQs

What makes Heera Agro different from other brands?

helping you save up to 40% on every purchase.

Do you provide delivery across India?

Yes, we offer safe and reliable shipping across India. Delivery charges may vary depending on your
location.

What payment methods do you accept?

You can pay securely through UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and other trusted online payment
options.

How do I know which product is right for my farm?

Our product pages include detailed descriptions, and our support team is always available to guide
you in choosing the right equipment.

What if I face an issue after purchase?

We have a dedicated support team to resolve your issue as quickly as possible.

## Story About Us

Since 1986, Heera Agro Industries has been committed to empowering farmers with high-quality
agricultural products. With over 20 years of expertise in drip irrigation and a direct-to-farmer
approach, we ensure affordable pricing by eliminating middlemen. Since entering eCommerce in 2011,
we’ve delivered over 60,000 orders, serving 5 lakh+ satisfied farmers across India. Our mission is
simple - to provide reliable, innovative solutions that help farmers save time, water, and money.

## FAQs

What makes Heera Agro different from other brands?

helping you save up to 40% on every purchase.

Do you provide delivery across India?

Yes, we offer safe and reliable shipping across India. Delivery charges may vary depending on your
location.

What payment methods do you accept?

You can pay securely through UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and other trusted online payment
options.

How do I know which product is right for my farm?

Our product pages include detailed descriptions, and our support team is always available to guide
you in choosing the right equipment.

What if I face an issue after purchase?

We have a dedicated support team to resolve your issue as quickly as possible.

## Welcome to Irrigation Consulting

Irrigation Consulting, with its team of Certified Irrigation Designers, spends hundreds of man-hours
on the design of every irrigation system. Our systems are designed with water conservation, energy
efficiency and future maintenance and system longevity in mind. Designs are custom to every site,
with design site visits walking the golf course included to make bid documents accurate. Our design
work includes sprinkler performance modeling, hydraulic analysis, and wiring circuit design for a
complete set of drawings.

### Importance of drip irrigation

Properly designed, installed, and managed, drip irrigation may help achieve water conservation by
reducing evaporation and deep drainage when compared to other types of irrigation such as flood or
overhead sprinklers since water can be more precisely applied to the plant roots. In addition, drip
can eliminate many diseases that are spread through water contact with the foliage. Finally, in
regions where water supplies are severely limited, there may be no actual water savings, but rather
simply an increase in production while using the same amount of water as before.

Properly designed, installed, and managed, drip irrigation may help achieve water conservation by
reducing evaporation and deep drainage when compared to other types of irrigation such as flood or
overhead sprinklers since water can be more precisely applied to the plant roots. In addition, drip
can eliminate many diseases that are spread through water contact with the foliage. Finally, in
regions where water supplies are severely limited, there may be no actual water savings, but rather
simply an increase in production while using the same amount of water as before.

# About Lawn Gear Lab

Two brothers with a passion for gardens, built into a resource for everyone who loves their outdoor
space.

[Mo and Min, the brothers behind Lawn Gear Lab]
Mo & Min — the brothers behind Lawn Gear Lab.

## Who We Are

Lawn Gear Lab is a lawn care, gardening, and outdoor living resource run by **Mo & Min** — brothers
who genuinely love spending time outdoors, getting their hands in the soil, and figuring out what
actually works in a real backyard. We cover everything from mowing schedules and fertilizer guides
to honest tool reviews and seasonal garden projects, all written in plain language that’s easy to
act on.

Our goal is simple: help you grow a healthier, greener outdoor space with less guesswork, less
wasted money, and more confidence in every decision you make for your yard.

## Our Story

[Mo sitting on green grass by a lake, reflecting outdoors] 📍 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia — at home
wherever there’s green grass underfoot.

Lawn Gear Lab started the way most good things do — out of personal frustration. Like a lot of
homeowners, we spent hours searching for reliable answers about lawn care and gardening, only to
find content that was either too vague, written for professionals, or quietly pushing products
without any real research behind the recommendations.

So we decided to build the resource we wished existed. One that explains the “why” behind every tip,
treats readers as intelligent adults, and only recommends products because they’re genuinely good —
not because they pay the highest commission.

What started as weekend projects in our own yard eventually became Lawn Gear Lab — a place for
anyone who wants to take better care of their outdoor space without the guesswork.

## Meet the Team

M

### Mo

Co-Founder & Lead Writer. Focuses on lawn care guides, tool reviews, mowing, fertilizing, and all
things yard maintenance.

Mi

### Min

Co-Founder & Gardening Editor. Covers plant care, flowers, raised beds, soil health, and making
outdoor spaces more beautiful.

## What We Cover

Lawn Gear Lab covers three core areas. First, lawn care and maintenance — mowing, watering,
fertilizing, weed control, and seasonal upkeep to keep your lawn healthy year-round. Second, tools
and gear — honest, research-backed reviews of mowers, trimmers, spreaders, and outdoor equipment so
you know what’s actually worth buying. Third, gardening and outdoor living — plant care guides,
raised bed advice, soil improvement tips, and project ideas for a thriving garden space.

## How We Recommend Products

Every product recommendation on Lawn Gear Lab is the result of genuine research. We evaluate user
feedback, product specifications, value for money, and real-world performance before making any
recommendation. We participate in affiliate programmes including the Amazon Associates Program and
the Home Depot Affiliate Program, which means we may earn a small commission if you purchase through
our links — at no additional cost to you. This helps keep the site running, but it never influences
which products we recommend. You can read more in our [Privacy Policy][15].

## Editorial Standards

We don’t publish content we wouldn’t stand behind. Every guide is written to be practically useful —
grounded in real experience, current best practices, and reliable sources. If something changes or
we get something wrong, we update it. Accuracy and usefulness are the two things we refuse to
compromise on.

## Get in Touch

Have a question, a topic suggestion, or want to reach out about a partnership? Visit our [Contact
page][16] to send us a message.

## Serving Maryland, Virginia & Washington DC

**Montgomery Irrigation Professional Contractors Cover All The Following Service Areas:**

**Maryland** including [Harford][22], [Baltimore][23], [Carroll][24], [Frederick][25], [Howard][26],
[Montgomery][27], [Anne Arundel][28], [Prince Georges][29], [Charles County and Southern MD][30],

[Arlington][41], [Loudoun][42], [Prince William][43] and [Fauquier VA][44].

** Sussex County DE**

**Montgomery Irrigation** is a full service irrigation contracting company serving Maryland, Sussex
DE, Northern Virginia, Washington DC, Richmond VA, Virginia Beach, and Charles Town WV areas. Our
company goal is to provide the highest level of customer service while providing quality products
and services. In order to achieve this goal, we must provide our associates with the best possible
training, equipment and support. The key to success in our organization is the people who work for
it!

[Residential Irrigation Installation & Repairs]
[Waterfall Pond & Stream Installation Maryland]

**Our services include:**
* Irrigation System Design
* Irrigation System Installation for your Gardens, Lawns, Landscaping
* Irrigation Maintenance - Spring Start Up, Summer Inspections, Fall Winterizations
* Irrigation Repairs - Waterlines, Sprinkler Head Repairs, Valves, Pumps, Controllers
* Lawn Irrigation System Service
* Drip Irrigation for Potted Plants, Gardens, Shrubs & Flowers
* Irrigation System Audits
* Pump System Installation and Service
* Drainage Installation and Service
* Landscape Lighting Installation and Service
* Installation and Service of Pond Aerator and Water Features
* Installation and Service of Ponds and Pond-less Waterfalls

**The type of customers our company provides irrigation services for include:**
* Residential Homes
* Commercial Businesses
* Athletic Fields
* Golf Courses
* High Schools
* Tennis Courts
* Nurseries and many other commercial businesses

We are proud members of ***The Irrigation Association***, ***The Landscape Contractors
Association***, ***Sports Turf Managers Association***, and the ***Virginia Irrigation
Association***, and hold the following certifications: ***Certified Landscape Irrigation Auditor***,
***Certified Irrigation Contractor***. We can service and repair all brands of lawn irrigation and
sprinkler systems. Our company has locations in Maryland, Northern Virginia and Richmond VA for fast
service. Call or email for details.

## Thinking GREEN?

We are, too, and have been following water conserving practices for many years! Talk to your
technician or call us in the office to talk about all the water saving devices and practices that we
have available for your irrigation system.

Montgomery Irrigation now has two certified backflow testers on staff. Many jurisdictions require
annual testing of your backflow preventer to ensure it is working properly. Even where this is not
required we highly suggest testing them yearly to ensure they are working properly to ensure your
water supply does not become contaminated.

Welcome to Sinoah!
As an innovator in China's drip irrigation equipment industry, Sinoah has 28 years of technology
accumulation and is committed to technology research and development. In the past decade, China's
drip irrigation equipment industry has mainly relied on imitating foreign technology, and Sinoah
firmly believes that independent innovation is the key to achieving breakthroughs. At the same time,
we pay more attention to customer needs and provide customized equipment solutions. Our equipment
has been widely recognized in more than 70 countries and regions such as the Middle East, North
Africa, and South America, and has established long-term and stable cooperative relationships.
Helped 20+ farmers increase crop yields, and 10+ factories provided equipment and solutions to
improve their production efficiency and save costs. In the future, Sinoah will continue to drive
development with innovation and continuously improve product quality and service levels. Thank you
for your attention and support!

[A stormwater management system installed next to a logistics warehouse | Pipelife]

#### Infrastructure

Pipe infrastructure is the lifeline of modern communities. Carrying water, energy and data, it keeps
us safe, clean and connected.

As your partner, we support you in planning, designing and delivering the right fit for every
project — with complete system solutions from source to consumer to disposal. 

[Pipelife Cooling Open]

#### Buildings

Pipe systems are essential in and around every building. From water supply and discharge to power
supply and indoor climate, they work quietly in the background to ensure our comfort and safety.

At Pipelife, we provide complete solutions to simplify work for designers and installers while
enabling healthy, safe and comfortable living environments for end users. 

[Irrigation Agriculture]

#### Agriculture

Advanced pipe systems are facilitating the future of farming. From precision irrigation to field
drainage, they manage water use, nurture soil and support healthy, abundant harvests.

We design tailored solutions — aligned with your land’s topography, soil and climate — that optimize
growth, conserve resources and simplify installation and maintenance.

Один поиск — шесть крупнейших мировых каталогов STL. Без регистрации, без рекламы, на русском языке.

01

### Один поиск — шесть платформ

Вместо того чтобы открывать [Thingiverse][21], [Cults3D][22], [Printables][23], [MakerWorld][24],
[Creality Cloud][25] и [3DToday][26] по отдельности — пишете запрос один раз и получаете лучшие STL
со всех площадок.

02

### Поиск на русском

Запрос отправляется параллельно на шесть платформ — для мировых каталогов он автоматически
переводится на английский. Результаты можно сортировать по популярности, новизне, лайкам,
скачиваниям и фильтровать только бесплатные модели.

03

### Что можно скачать

[Подставки][27], [органайзеры][28], [драконы][29], [фигурки D&D][30], [машины][31], [танки][32],
[вазы][33], [игрушки][34], [антистрессы][35], [STL для ЧПУ][36], [брелоки][37].

04

### Поддерживаемые форматы

**STL** — стандарт 3D-печати, **3MF** — с цветами и настройками, **OBJ** — для рендера, **STEP** —
для CAD, **FBX** — для игр. Открываются в Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer.

## Что такое Polyzon

Один поиск — шесть крупнейших мировых каталогов STL. Без регистрации, без рекламы, на русском языке.

01

### Один поиск — шесть платформ

Вместо того чтобы открывать [Thingiverse][21], [Cults3D][22], [Printables][23], [MakerWorld][24],
[Creality Cloud][25] и [3DToday][26] по отдельности — пишете запрос один раз и получаете лучшие STL
со всех площадок.

02

### Поиск на русском

Запрос отправляется параллельно на шесть платформ — для мировых каталогов он автоматически
переводится на английский. Результаты можно сортировать по популярности, новизне, лайкам,
скачиваниям и фильтровать только бесплатные модели.

03

### Что можно скачать

[Подставки][27], [органайзеры][28], [драконы][29], [фигурки D&D][30], [машины][31], [танки][32],
[вазы][33], [игрушки][34], [антистрессы][35], [STL для ЧПУ][36], [брелоки][37].

04

### Поддерживаемые форматы

**STL** — стандарт 3D-печати, **3MF** — с цветами и настройками, **OBJ** — для рендера, **STEP** —
для CAD, **FBX** — для игр. Открываются в Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer.

professional among clients. Whether the task is simple or complex, Mike approaches each project with
the same level of dedication. You can count on his expertise to get the job done right the first
time.

Integrity is at the core of everything we do. We pride ourselves on honesty, offering fair rates and
transparent solutions that fit your budget. Our team believes in building trust through clear
communication and ethical practices. You’ll never encounter hidden fees or surprise charges—just
straightforward service you can rely on. When you work with us, you can feel confident that your
needs are being met with honesty and respect.

Our commitment to reliability means we’re always here when you need us. We offer 24/7 emergency
services to ensure you’re never left waiting during a critical moment. Whether it’s a late-night
issue or a weekend emergency, you can count on us to respond quickly and professionally. Our team is
trained to handle urgent situations with efficiency and care. You can trust that we’ll be there—day
or night—delivering dependable service when it matters most.

## Overcoming Water Challenges With Precision

Dealing with water issues can be more than just inconvenient—it can disrupt your home, landscaping,
and peace of mind. At Precision Well Drilling & Irrigation, LLC, we specialize in delivering
dependable solutions as a leading irrigation company serving Port St. Lucie, Fort Pierce, and
surrounding areas. With owners Jess and Mike at the helm, our team brings hands-on experience,
honest communication, and a commitment to solving your water problems with care. From restoring
water flow in older wells to fixing failing irrigation systems, we provide expert guidance and
reliable service every step of the way. Our goal is not just to fix the problem but to create
long-term results that reduce stress and protect your property.

We offer a full range of [irrigation services][91], [pump installation services][92], [well
drilling][93], and [artesian well repair][94]—each tailored to meet your specific water needs.
Whether you’re upgrading an outdated system or need emergency support, we bring precision and
professionalism to every job. As a trusted irrigation company, we focus on quality workmanship,
transparent pricing, and responsive service to ensure your complete satisfaction. From enhancing
your lawn’s hydration with modern irrigation solutions to restoring function in aging wells, you can
rely on us for honest, effective service. Let Precision Well Drilling & Irrigation, LLC be your
go-to partner for reliable water solutions in the Treasure Coast region.

## Welcome to Responsive Drip Irrigation

Responsive Drip Irrigation (RDI) is the company, owner of the new method in water delivery that has
completely reset the standard for irrigation systems. GrowStream™ tube is the world’s first and only
plant-responsive irrigation and fertigation system which allows the plant to self-regulate its own
water delivery, resulting in unmatched water savings and plant performance versus all existing forms
of forced irrigation. RDI is present in more than 40 countries and growing.

**RDI’s number one goal is to provide a solution that eases the water crisis and its consequences.
Besides scarcity, the main problem being faced is the lack of potable water in the world, due to
inadequate management of water resources. Water continues to be contaminated due to poor or no
sanitation, the discharge of domestic sewage and industrial waste without proper treatment, and
chemicals from agricultural activities.**

**With growing global awareness that the planet’s limited resources are in crisis, the next step is
to take advantage of new technology, such as GrowStream™ system. This new method provides a
sustainable future, but can also begin to regenerate the natural resources.**

## SIMPLE TO INSTALL

**Simple to operate with low maintenance cost.**
**System can be used season after season, outlasting drip irrigation.**

## LESS WATER & FERTILIZER

**Uses 30-50% less water and fertilizer. Works with poor quality water, treated wastewater, and in
non-arable land or degraded soil.**

## BETTER RESULTS

**Healthier plants, less weeds, pests and diseases, creating beautiful and unique landscapes in
diverse applications.**

## NATURE-DRIVEN

**Variable flow rate that adjust and self-regulates to plants’ needs. Diverse plant types can be
irrigated on the same zone.**

## SUSTAINABLE

**Greenscapes in cities, including turf and trees, can be preserved by reducing water usage or
treated wastewater, which returns back into nature, further filtering through the soil and plants.**

## URBAN SOLUTION

**Reduces the Urban Heat Island effect by preserving or expanding green spaces in urban areas.
Prevents fertilizer run-off into storm drains and water supplies.**

## Welcome to Responsive Drip Irrigation

Responsive Drip Irrigation (RDI) is the company, owner of the new method in water delivery that has
completely reset the standard for irrigation systems. GrowStream™ tube is the world’s first and only
plant-responsive irrigation and fertigation system which allows the plant to self-regulate its own
water delivery, resulting in unmatched water savings and plant performance versus all existing forms
of forced irrigation. RDI is present in more than 40 countries and growing.

**RDI’s number one goal is to provide a solution that eases the water crisis and its consequences.
Besides scarcity, the main problem being faced is the lack of potable water in the world, due to
inadequate management of water resources. Water continues to be contaminated due to poor or no
sanitation, the discharge of domestic sewage and industrial waste without proper treatment, and
chemicals from agricultural activities.**

**With growing global awareness that the planet’s limited resources are in crisis, the next step is
to take advantage of new technology, such as GrowStream™ system. This new method provides a
sustainable future, but can also begin to regenerate the natural resources.**

## SIMPLE TO INSTALL

**Simple to operate with low maintenance cost.**
**System can be used season after season, outlasting drip irrigation.**

## LESS WATER & FERTILIZER

**Uses 30-50% less water and fertilizer. Works with poor quality water, treated wastewater, and in
non-arable land or degraded soil.**

## BETTER RESULTS

**Healthier plants, less weeds, pests and diseases, creating beautiful and unique landscapes in
diverse applications.**

## NATURE-DRIVEN

**Variable flow rate that adjust and self-regulates to plants’ needs. Diverse plant types can be
irrigated on the same zone.**

## SUSTAINABLE

**Greenscapes in cities, including turf and trees, can be preserved by reducing water usage or
treated wastewater, which returns back into nature, further filtering through the soil and plants.**

## URBAN SOLUTION

**Reduces the Urban Heat Island effect by preserving or expanding green spaces in urban areas.
Prevents fertilizer run-off into storm drains and water supplies.**

“Our mission is to sell tractors, diesel engines and agricultural machines throughout the world,

Province. We have been committed to providing efficient and reliable irrigation pipeline solutions
for global agriculture. To meet the diverse needs of different customers in application fields such
as drip irrigation, mobile sprinkler irrigation and micro-sprinkler irrigation.

materials, welding technology and automation.  Our main product is PE lay flat hose, PP lay flat

# Strawberries with Italian charisma

The roots of Idris go back to the eighties when Johan Aelterman was teaching soil physics and
irrigation management in Egypt at the universities of Ain Shams and Cairo. During this period Johan
got fascinated by the new technologies of hydroponic production.

From that time Idris started in consulting at first in irrigation management and specifically drip
irrigation.

In 1985 he was one of the founders of Ter Spore bvba that pioneered in the strawberry production on
NFT and substrates. As the strawberry growing on substrate also required top quality plant material
Idris got from 1992 involved in a cooperation with the Italian nurseries Vivai Mazzoni and Salvi
Vivai. And soon the cooperation with the breeding company CIV started in search for better
varieties.

End the nineties the Idris was transformed in Idris Trading and Consulting Ltd.

[[CIV]][41]
[[Mazzoni]][42]
[[Salvi]][43]

## Varieties

The CIV varieties cover a very wide range from cool climates over Mediterranean climates towards
tropical climates.

# The Irrigation Authority

Landscape irrigation spans a broad service ecosystem — from residential drip systems and turf
sprinklers to commercial-grade smart controllers and municipal compliance retrofits. This page
explains what the provider network covers, how its providers are structured, how to read provider
entries accurately, and how the provider network fits within the larger set of reference resources
on this domain. Understanding these parameters helps readers locate the right service category and
evaluate providers against objective criteria rather than marketing claims.

## Relationship to Other Network Resources

This provider network operates alongside a set of reference and guidance pages that provide
technical context, regulatory background, and decision frameworks for landscape irrigation. The
[Irrigation & Landscaping Services Overview][3] page establishes the full scope of irrigation
service categories recognized in this network. The How to Use This Landscaping Services Resource
page provides structured guidance on navigating providers, applying filters, and matching service
categories to specific project needs.

Topic-context pages — such as [Irrigation Provider Selection Criteria][4] and [Irrigation Licensing
& Certifications in Landscaping][5] — function as companion references. They define the professional
standards, licensing bodies (including the Irrigation Association's Certified Irrigation Contractor
credential), and evaluation benchmarks that inform the provider network's classification logic.
Readers who want technical background on a service type before reviewing provider providers should
consult those pages first. The provider network itself is a structured index of providers, not a
substitute for technical guidance.

## How to Interpret Providers

Each provider in the Landscaping Services Providers index represents a provider entry organized
around four fields: geographic service area, primary service category, secondary service categories,
and credential or licensing status where publicly verifiable.

**Geographic service area** is stated at the city, county, or metropolitan statistical area level.
National or multi-state providers are tagged accordingly but are not ranked above local specialists.

**Primary service category** reflects the provider's dominant offering. The provider network
recognizes the following primary categories, drawn from the classification structure used throughout
this domain:

**Secondary categories** indicate services the provider offers but does not specialize in. A
provider verified primarily under irrigation system installation may carry a secondary tag for
seasonal startup — meaning that service is available but not the provider's core operational focus.

**Credential status** reflects publicly verified affiliations with recognized bodies such as the
Irrigation Association, state contractor licensing boards, or EPA WaterSense program participation.
Providers do not verify credentials independently; readers should confirm license numbers through
the relevant state contractor licensing database before engaging a provider.

A provider verified under [Commercial Irrigation Landscaping Services][6] is not necessarily
unqualified for residential work, but the provider reflects where the provider's documented project
history and equipment capacity are concentrated.

## Purpose of This Provider Network

The provider network exists to reduce the information asymmetry between property owners, facilities
managers, and landscape contractors when selecting irrigation service providers. The landscape
irrigation industry in the United States is fragmented across more than 100,000 contracting entities
(U.S. Census Bureau, Statistics of U.S. Businesses), ranging from sole-operator maintenance
companies to regional design-build firms. No single federal licensing standard applies nationally;
requirements vary by state and, in some jurisdictions, by municipality.

This fragmentation makes provider comparison difficult without a structured reference point. The
provider network addresses that gap by presenting providers within explicit service categories —
distinguishing, for example, a firm that specializes in [Drip Irrigation Landscaping Services][7]
from one focused on [Turf Irrigation Landscaping Services][8]. These are operationally distinct
disciplines: drip systems operate at low pressure (typically 15–30 PSI) with emitter-level delivery,
while turf sprinkler systems require pressure zones, rotary or fixed-head coverage planning, and
separate hydraulic calculations. Provider them under a single undifferentiated "irrigation" label
would obscure meaningful differences in provider expertise.

The provider network does not rank providers by quality, revenue, or review score. It organizes them
by service scope and geography so readers can build a qualified shortlist appropriate to their
project type. [Skip to main content][1]

## What Is Included

The provider network covers irrigation and water-management services that are directly integrated
with landscape systems. Inclusion requires that the service involve physical site work, system
design, or ongoing maintenance of irrigation infrastructure on residential, commercial, or
institutional properties within the United States.

Included service types fall into three operational tiers:

**Installation and design services** — New-construction irrigation layout, retrofit of existing
systems, [landscape irrigation zoning design][9], and integration of [smart irrigation
controls][10]. These engagements typically require contractor licensing in most states.

**Maintenance and seasonal services** — Ongoing system inspections, [seasonal startup and
winterization][11], backflow preventer testing per local ordinance, and [irrigation
troubleshooting][12]. These services recur on an annual or semi-annual cycle and are often governed
by separate service agreements.

**Specialty and compliance services** — [Rainwater harvesting system integration][13], [greywater
irrigation][14] where state law permits, [irrigation compliance and regulatory services][15], and
water audit services aligned with EPA WaterSense or local water district requirements.

General landscaping services — mowing, planting, hardscaping, tree care — are outside the provider
network's scope unless the provider's primary or secondary category includes a qualifying irrigation
service. Plumbing contractors who do not specialize in landscape irrigation systems are similarly
excluded, even if their license class technically permits irrigation work.
